description: This file defines the interface for the Webpa Abstraction Layer, including function declarations for getting and setting attributes related to Webpa parameters. It also includes necessary headers and copyright/license information.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a list of parameters, returning attribute name/value pairs along with status information.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets attribute values for a list of parameters, updating their status accordingly.
